title: H02 Fitness-to-Travel Assessment
description: Assessment that the animals are fit for the intended journey (Art. 3(b), Annex I Chapter I), performed before loading; short-lived.

x-traced.status: pre-project draft — subject to change in T4.1
x-traced.issuer: Official veterinarian at the place of departure for long journeys between Member States (Art. 15(2)); otherwise the keeper at the place of departure (Art. 8(1)).
verifiers: Official veterinarians at control posts and exit points (Art. 21(1)(c))
Keeper and competent authority at destination
legalBasis: Reg (EC) No 1/2005 Annex I, Chapter I
x-traced.forwardCompatibility: COM(2023) 770 (proposal) — forward-compatibility only: Art. 17 (obligations for keepers prior to the journey, incl. fitness for transport).
x-traced.integrity: Issuer electronic seal; Tier 1 sealed photo evidence may be attached by reference.
useCases: UC-3 official verification at control points
openQuestions: Tolerance window and whether a keeper-issued variant is needed for short journeys in the pilot.

outcome.description: Overall outcome for the consignment as loaded.

animalsExcluded.description: Animals found unfit and not loaded.

conditions.description: Conditions under Annex I, Chapter I, point 3 (e.g. slightly injured, transport under veterinary supervision).

assessor.description: Assessor; for long journeys between Member States the check is part of the official animal health checks (Art. 15(2)).

validUntil.description: Planned departure plus a tolerance fixed in T4.1.
